findings.root_cause: JSON sender handles both independent packages but stored sha256 pins were enabled only for LINE WORKS. Standalone could reseal replaced/untracked bytes under their new hash.
findings.fix: use existing _hermes_free(cfg,target) for stored attachment pins; no dependencies/API/schema change
findings.regression_after: six cases included in final 224-pass Junit (both Slack/Discord; before/after fingerprint and untracked attachment)

findings.root_cause: explicit artifact project equality in JOIN excluded legacy project=NULL LLM rows that current_fact_pred and urgency display intentionally permit by unique message/hash.
findings.fix: join by message_id; retain the shared current_fact_pred project/hash/current-generation restriction
findings.regression_after: legacy NULL and scoped LLM both enqueue/check_delivery/send; incompatible project mutation is rejected by g1 and rolled back; all in final PASS

findings.hypothesis: top-level interactive accepted could escalate a suppressed/uncovered member
findings.evidence: _base requires intersection of frozen message_ids and delivered ic.coverage; test_partial_interactive_acceptance_is_not_delivery_of_suppressed_member and sealed E2 PASS

findings.hypothesis: text initial delivery could create unconfirmable E2
findings.evidence: _stage stops text after E1, _base text excludes sealed batch; text E2 enqueue/send-time cancellation tests PASS

findings.hypothesis: old generation or hidden page acknowledgement could silence urgency
findings.evidence: _confirmed matches current source_generation/source_fp and shown integer member; page/old-generation regressions PASS

findings.hypothesis: digest built outside write lock could enqueue twice
findings.evidence: latest event id compared after BEGIN IMMEDIATE; test_body_is_built_outside_the_write_lock proves competing insert wins

findings.hypothesis: hold could rescue an already/uncertain delivered event and duplicate it
findings.evidence: _hold_event reloads current receipt; holds disable rescue for unknown outcome, corrupt receipt retains invalid_progress; current-receipt/crash tests PASS

findings.hypothesis: _fail_event old ev.progress could suppress/park after a newly accepted chunk on StaleSend/DeferredSend
findings.evidence: semantic_gate/render_gate convert changes in_progress into FreezeSend (unconditional hold); current urgent fixed short text is below1900, and retry entry ev already has previous progress. No current production path was found; no speculative fix introduced.
